book_appointment.description: Book a service with a provider for a customer, found by email or added. Checks the time is free first, as the booking page does.

parameters.description: The service to book.
parameters.name: service

parameters.description: Who the appointment is with. They must offer the service.
parameters.name: provider

parameters.description: When it starts. A time typed without a time zone, such as 2026-11-10 14:30 from 'Get available times', is the provider's.

parameters.name: last_name

parameters.name: phone

parameters.description: The appointment's status. Defaults to the first, Booked.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Check the time is one of the provider's free times first, as the booking page does. Turn off to book it anyway, as staff can in the calendar.
parameters.display_name: Only if the time is free

booked_at.description: When it was booked, in Easy!Appointments' own time zone

calendar_url.description: The appointment in Easy!Appointments' calendar, for staff

duration_minutes.description: How long it is, in minutes

end.description: When it ends, in the provider's time zone

ends_at.description: When it ends, as ISO 8601 with the time zone's offset

id.description: The appointment's ID, for the other Easy!Appointments steps

manage_url.description: The customer's page to reschedule or cancel it, as in their emails

meeting_link.description: Its video meeting link, if it has one

new_customer.description: Whether the customer was added for this booking
